'''2000 Endor Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Endor region (Idaho, Montana, Oregon, Washington, Wyoming) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00endor">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=endor 2000 Regionals: Endor], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010727140708/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=endor Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Jeremy LaMere|Jeremy Lamere]] of Box Elder, Montana won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 1 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Wizards of the Coast Game Center 4518 University Way NE Seattle, Washington
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Doug Taylor]]
* '''Players:''' 67<ref name="tr-d958" />

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* The hub (from Decipher's DecipherCon 2000 qualifier list) names Jeremy LaMere as the winner, but LaMere's own report and Douglas Harvilla's both say John Hawkins beat LaMere 2–0 in the final; LaMere says he took second, and Harvilla says Hawkins is representing the Endor region at Worlds.<ref name="tr-d958" />
* Douglas Harvilla's report gives 3rd place to 'Tom Kitzman'; Jeremy LaMere's report lists David Kitzman in the top 3.<ref name="tr-d958" />
* The hub (from Decipher's DecipherCon 2000 qualifier list) names Jeremy LaMere as the winner, but LaMere's own report and Douglas Harvilla's both say John Hawkins beat LaMere 2–0 in the final; LaMere says he took second, and Harvilla says Hawkins is representing the Endor region at Worlds.<ref name="tr-d982" />
